projects.title: Selected Works & Architecture
projects.subtitle: Production-grade frontend and full-stack software built with hardware-grade precision, live data streaming, and FinTech design aesthetics.

crypto.title: Crypto Trade Hub
crypto.description: A high-performance live trading bot terminal and simulated portfolio interface built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Connects to Binance live WebSocket streams, logs sub-second order fills, calculates real-time PnL metrics, and presents execution logs inside an interactive terminal.

donnons.title: Donnons.ch (Sixième Sens)
donnons.description: Official blood donation coordination platform mandated by the Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève (HUG). Built with an intentional, handcrafted aesthetic utilizing a reactive Vue.js interface and a resilient Laravel API backend to streamline mobile blood drive collection points.

catholicRoute.title: Catholic Route
catholicRoute.description: An educational discovery platform focused on state-of-the-art interactive UX/UI components. Features an instant global Ctrl+K search palette, responsive route orchestration, and contextual floating glossary term definitions for complex ecclesiastical and historical concepts.

marriage.title: Private Event & RSVP Platform (2026)
marriage.description: A bespoke private event management platform designed with an elegant editorial UI. Features stateful guest RSVP management, multi-step meal preference handling, and strict private routing protocols to maintain guest privacy.

about.title: Steve Benjamin
about.summary: Full-stack Media Engineer (HEIG-VD) with an Electronics CFC background (CPNV). Bridging the strict discipline of hardware design with high-performance modern web engineering.

section1.title: The Bridge: Electronics to Media Engineering
section1.p1: My engineering foundation was forged in hardware and circuit design, earning a Swiss
section1.cfcDef: Certificat Fédéral de Capacité — Swiss Federal Certificate of Vocational Education and Training in Electronics.
section1.cpnvDef: Centre Professionnel du Nord Vaudois — Swiss technical vocational institution.
section1.p1End: . Working with embedded microcontrollers and signal processing instilled an unyielding respect for memory constraints, deterministic timings, and zero-defect execution.
section1.p2: Transitioning to a Bachelor in Media Engineering at
section1.heigvdDef: Haute École d'Ingénierie et de Gestion du Canton de Vaud — Swiss university of applied sciences.
section1.p2End: , I translated that hardware rigor to the web. In modern FinTech dashboards and high-frequency trading terminals, latency, state predictability, and visual clarity are paramount.

section2.title: Leadership & Human Engagement
section2.glgbDesc: Serving as a youth leader within
section2.glgbDef: Youth organization dedicated to community event orchestration, mentoring, and inspirational leadership.
section2.glgbEnd: , driving large-scale youth gatherings, team coordination, logistics planning, and cross-generational communication.
section2.ficfDef: Fondation Internationale pour la Coopération et la Fraternité — Humanitarian medical and educational foundation.
section2.ficfEnd: , actively participating in mobile medical camps in India and facilitating bilingual communications across English, French, and local dialects.

section3.title: Multilingual Proficiency
section3.subtitle: Fluent in international business, technical, and cross-cultural communication environments.

section4.title: Interests & Pursuits
section4.bballDesc: Enthusiast for court footwork and kinetic balance. A keen advocate for flat-soled performance basketball footwear engineered specifically for court traction, low center-of-gravity, and lateral stability.
section4.runningDesc: Long-distance road and trail running for cardiovascular resilience, mental clarity, and systematic endurance under pressure.
section4.musicDesc: Pianist and music producer composing within FL Studio. Balancing digital audio workstation (DAW) synthesis with acoustic keyboard harmony.
